info.name: AWS Fault Injection Simulator API
info.description:
AWS Fault Injection Simulator (FIS) is a fully managed service for running fault injection experiments on AWS. This API enables creating experiment templates, starting and stopping experiments, managing safety levers, and configuring multi-account targets for chaos engineering.

Contact Support:
 Name: Amazon Web Services
